expectations.name: opens-with-counts
expected_behavior: States the three counts and stops, letting the user pick a list
Lists `deferred` first
Starts no grilling and drafts no page before the user picks
No preamble; each count stated once

expectations.name: reclassifies-rather-than-skipping
expected_behavior: Reclassifies the gap with `update_gap` `answer: unknown`, and says so
Writes nothing under the `kb` folder and hands nothing to `srd:kb`: a reclassification changes only the gap
Does not treat it as a skip or leave the gap marked deferred
Files no new gap and closes none: no `report_gap`, `fill_gap`, or `wontfix_gap`, and no talk of a documentation gap

expectations.name: clusters-gaps-and-drafts-outside-the-corpus
expected_behavior: Clusters the two duplicates and surfaces the cluster size as priority
Checks the corpus before drafting, separating content that is absent from content that is present but unranked
Writes the draft outside every corpus source, the `kb` folder included
Publishes nothing itself; given only the published URL it fills no gap and says the cluster stays open until the page is pulled into the corpus

expectations.name: sweeps-an-abandoned-srd
expected_behavior: Before the counts, files exactly one `wrong` gap per uncovered section citing `crew-seats` — two `report_gap` calls, each submitted open without asking
The "Mission visibility" gap's `detail` names the co-attesting SRD folder `payload-booking`
Files nothing for "Crew seat limit" and adds no hit to `gap-0040`
Reports the sweep in the opening counts line and edits no KB section

expectations.name: rechecks-stale-gaps
expected_behavior: Refreshes `gap-0050` with `fill_gap`, the identical `filled_by`, and `complete: true`; does not reopen it
Reopens `gap-0051` with `reopen_gap` and a reason; never fills it
Re-points `gap-0052` with `fill_gap` at `1000000110#cold-archive`, `complete: true`; never passes the vanished ref
Lists stale gaps before any fill, and reports the re-check as a clause of the opening counts line

expectations.name: ask-writes-one-message-per-person
expected_behavior: Prints one paste-ready block per person, Maya R and John K, each holding the part-kit expiry question
Leaves the already-asked gap and the gap naming nobody out of every block; counts the already-asked one and offers `ask reminders`
Keeps gap ids and @-mentions out of the blocks
Sets `asked` only after the user confirms the sends: no `update_gap` before, then one with a date on `gap-0061` and none on the other two
